title: USDA AD-3030
description: Representations regarding felony conviction and tax delinquent status for corporate applicants. No automated eligibility determination is made.
notes: The pinned DAT/PDF states OMB expiration September 30, 2025; confirm current official metadata before production rather than inventing a renewal.
Only corporations need this form, according to source instructions. Applicability is package context, not an invented form answer.
TaxIDNumber is the last four digits, stored as text with leading zeros. The DAT digits-only rule is stricter than the source XSD length-only restriction and is explicitly retained.
ApplicantAddress remains the source whole-text answer, and ApplicantName retains its 140-character contract instead of being forced into OrgName60.
Signature/date and title are synthetic external context in examples; no signing, authentic prepopulation or submission is claimed.
Date display is an explicit library presentation proposal: ISO JSON/XML date instead of the DAT MM-DD-YYYY display.
risks: Current OMB validity, package applicability, source-owned context and date presentation need actual integration/review. Agent verification is not human acceptance.

The DAT requires clickable USDA complaint-page and mailto links. Their exact destinations are preserved as text in the layout; the current library/SGG description renderer emits plain paragraphs. Clickable links remain an explicit presentation integration gap.
